extDescription.message: Copy the page title and URL, cleaned up by per-site rules. Built-in rules for GitHub and Jira; add your own for other sites.

toastCopiedWithFallback.message: Copied using the page title because the title element was not found.

toastTitleNotFound.message: Could not find the title on this page.

toastCopyFailed.message: Failed to copy to the clipboard.

toastFailed.message: Could not copy. See the extension's service worker console for details.

popupFailed.message: Could not copy on this page.

optionsDescription.message: Rules are evaluated from the top. The first rule that matches the page URL formats the copied title and URL. Pages that match no rule are copied with the page title and URL as they are.

rulesOrderHelp.message: When several rules match a page, the one higher in the list is used; drag the handle to change the order.

dragHandle.message: Drag to reorder. You can also focus this handle and press the up and down arrow keys.

confirmReset.message: Discard your changes and reset this rule to the built-in definition?

importExportHelp.message: Export saves custom rules, edited built-in rules, the order, and enabled states. Unedited built-in rules are not included. Import replaces all current settings.

schemaHelp.message: Exported files reference the JSON Schema, so editors can check and complete rules you write by hand.

confirmImport.message: Replace all current settings with the contents of this file?

fieldMatchHelp.message: Conditions are tried from the top. Values captured by the first matching condition are used in the templates.

patternHelpUrlPattern.message: Example: https://*.atlassian.net/browse/:key. The query and hash are not matched; use query parameters instead.

patternHelpRegex.message: Matched against the whole URL. Named groups such as (?<key>...) become variables.

fieldFallback.message: Use the page title when the title element is not found

selectorsHelp.message: CSS selectors tried from the top. Leave empty to always use the page title.

fieldStrip.message: Patterns to remove from the page title

stripHelp.message: Applied in order when the page title is used. Each pattern removes only its first match.

templateHelp.message: Use {name} for captured values, and {title}, {host}, and {origin}. {title} is available only in the label. Write {{ and }} for literal braces.

saveFailed.message: Fix the errors and save again.

quotaItemTooLarge.message: This rule is too large to save (limit: 8 KB).

quotaTotalTooLarge.message: The settings exceed the storage limit (100 KB).

issue_titleInUrl.message: {title} cannot be used in the URL template

issue_urlNotAbsolute.message: Must produce an absolute URL that starts with http:// or https://

issue_noTitleSource.message: A rule without selectors must allow the page title

issue_invalidConditionType.message: Unsupported condition type "$VALUE$". Use urlpattern or regex

issue_invalidId.message: A rule ID can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and -

issue_invalidVariableName.message: The variable name $VALUE$ must start with a letter, _, or $$ and contain only letters, digits, _, and $$

issue_templateInvalidPlaceholder.message: The { at character $VALUE$ is not closed or does not contain a valid variable name. Write {{ for a literal {

issue_templateUnmatchedBrace.message: The } at character $VALUE$ has no matching {. Write }} for a literal }

issue_reservedVariable.message: $VALUE$ is a reserved variable name and cannot be captured

issue_undefinedVariable.message: The variable $VALUE$ is not captured by every condition

issue_duplicateRuleId.message: The rule ID $VALUE$ is used more than once

issue_idMismatch.message: Does not match the ID the rule is stored under ($VALUE$)

loc_conditionFallback.message: Page title fallback of URL condition $INDEX$
